summary: PHILEON Customer Experience Logic Finalization — backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Backend: 23/23 in tests/test_customer_experience_phase.py PASS (14 base + 9 new for email CTA + admin GET). Broader regression (excluding pre-existing-drift suites test_true_vine, test_phileon_api, test_adaptive_pricing_live_integration): 942 pass, 1 fail — the fail is the documented gold-spot drift test_dynamic_ring_migrated_to_approved_usd[annie-rose-foundation-700000] (owner-accepted, not a launch risk). All new behavior verified: VIEW ORDER STATUS CTA embedded in build_customer_paid_email + build_customer_shipment_email with exact URL ${PHILEON_ORDER_STATUS_URL_BASE}/orders/{order_number}/status?token={email_status_token}; omitted when email_status_token missing; _order_status_link refuses non-http(s) bases (javascript:alert(1) → None); order status endpoint continues to verify status_token_hash (200 for correct token, 403 for wrong) even with plaintext email_status_token also on doc; admin GET /admin/orders/{order_number} → 401/403 no auth, 401 bad JWT, 404 with valid admin JWT on missing order, projection never leaks email_status_token, status_token_hash, id, provider_session_id, provider_payment_intent_id, webhook_event_ids, presentment.fx_rate / fx_rate_source. Frontend: /admin/shipments renders admin-shipments-page for authenticated admin; unauthenticated visitor is redirected to /admin/login (AdminLayout guard). Lookup form (admin-shipments-lookup-form/order-input/lookup-btn) → PHI-DOES-NOT-EXIST triggers admin-shipments-lookup-error 'Order PHI-DOES-NOT-EXIST was not found.'. With a paid order (mocked): admin-shipments-order-card renders with order-number, customer, payment-status, fulfillment-status, total, form-card, carrier/tracking/URL inputs, submit-btn. Empty carrier → admin-shipments-validation-error 'Carrier is required.' + submit disabled. Bad tracking URL `javascript:alert(1)` → 'must start with http:// or https://' + submit disabled. Valid submit → admin-shipments-confirm-backdrop opens; confirming triggers admin-shipments-confirm-submit → success flow. Already-shipped order shows admin-shipments-already-shipped badge and hides the form-card, and surfaces admin-shipments-existing-tracking with UPS/1Z999/shipped_at/tracking link. Full-page leak scan on all admin-shipments states found NO raw JWTs, Stripe IDs, evt_/pi_/cs_test_ substrings, status_token_hash, or webhook metadata anywhere in the DOM. Historical order PHI-20260901-4CBC5C not touched.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful mark-shipped submit, the admin-shipments-success block is rendered inside the {order && !alreadyShipped} conditional AND the reset useEffect keyed on order.order_number clears submitResult on order refresh — the moment the follow-up fetchOrder() returns the now-shipped order, both the success card and the form-card unmount together. The admin only sees the top-right 'SHIPPED' badge as confirmation. Functional (they know it worked) but the explicit 'Customer notification sent.' line disappears immediately, which is a mild UX regression compared to a persistent toast/banner. Suggest: hoist submitResult out of the form-card wrapper, or keep it in a top-of-page banner region so it survives the shipped-state re-render.

action_items: OPTIONAL / low-priority UX polish: preserve the 'Order marked as SHIPPED · Customer notification sent.' confirmation after the post-submit order refresh (currently unmounts with the form-card once alreadyShipped=true). Move admin-shipments-success out of the form-card conditional, or keep a small persistent status banner near the order header.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/order_emails.py::_order_status_link correctly gates on http(s):// prefix on base URL after urlparse fallback — javascript: base is rejected → CTA omitted from both paid and shipment emails. urllib.parse.quote() applied to both order_number and token, so exotic values cannot smuggle URL structure into the anchor.

backend/routes/admin_orders.py::get_order uses explicit field whitelist projection (not blacklist) — plaintext email_status_token, status_token_hash, provider_session_id, provider_payment_intent_id, webhook_event_ids, presentment.fx_rate/fx_rate_source all excluded by construction. Confirmed via test_admin_get_order_never_returns_secret_fields.

backend/routes/admin_orders.py::mark_shipped keeps the atomic find_one_and_update on `shipping_notification_sent: {$ne: True}` — duplicate calls fall through to a plain update_one WITHOUT invoking send_shipment_email. Idempotency of the customer email is preserved; confirmed by test_mark_shipped_first_call_sends_email_second_is_noop (single email fires across two calls).

frontend/AdminShipments.jsx correctly renders only whitelisted admin-facing fields, never echoes the raw admin JWT, and uses isSafeTrackingUrl on both input validation AND display of existing tracking URL. Consistent belt-and-braces posture with backend.

Pre-existing regressions preserved (not caused by this pass): tests/test_usd_only_migration.py::test_dynamic_ring_migrated_to_approved_usd[annie-rose-foundation-700000] (gold-spot drift, owner-accepted); tests/test_adaptive_pricing_live_integration and tests/test_phileon_api excluded per PRD.

success_rate.backend: 23/23 customer-experience phase (100%); 942/943 broader regression (99.9%, 1 pre-existing gold-spot drift)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all admin-shipments flows (page render, auth-guard, lookup 404, order card, form validation, unsafe-URL rejection, confirm modal, already-shipped state, leak scan)

test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via `python -c 'from server import create_token; print(create_token("admin"))'` and seeded into localStorage.phileon_admin_token before navigating to /admin/shipments (per iteration_19 pattern).
seed_data_creation: None. Playwright page.route() was used to mock /api/admin/orders/PHI-FAKE-PAID and /api/admin/orders/PHI-SHIPPED-ONE responses at the browser boundary for the paid + already-shipped UI states — no DB writes. Historical PHI-20260901-4CBC5C never queried or mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration is green for the two P0 launch items (VIEW ORDER STATUS CTA in paid + shipment emails; /admin/shipments UI). The only surfacing feedback is a LOW-priority UX polish on AdminShipments.jsx — the success banner unmounts with the form-card because both live under the {order && !alreadyShipped} branch and submitResult is reset by the useEffect keyed on order.order_number. The 'Shipped' badge is the sole persistent confirmation. Two pre-existing regressions remain gated: test_usd_only_migration::annie-rose-foundation gold-spot drift and test_adaptive_pricing_live_integration::test_canonical_order_stays_usd_with_cad — both documented in PRD, not launch risks. STRIPE_MODE=test preserved. PHI-20260901-4CBC5C untouched.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in scope. LOW-priority UX polish item on AdminShipments post-submit success visibility is the only recommendation.
